purpose: Resolve the architecture uncertainty for the confirmatory request-context experiment: determine whether context should enter additively or through explicit context-item/user interactions while preserving a small, ranking-relevant change.
query: Context-aware recommender ranking architectures that model interactions between request context (tab, hour, weekday) and user/item features, especially factorization machines, DeepFM, DCN, or lightweight interaction models; compare effects on within-user GAUC and nDCG@5 under temporal evaluation and discuss whether additive models can exploit context features

purpose: Resolve the objective and training uncertainty before spending an official experiment, specifically how to optimize ordering while maintaining both GAUC and nDCG@5 without changing the fixed evaluator or using unavailable impression outcomes.
query: Learning-to-rank objectives and training methods for implicit-feedback recommendation when evaluation combines within-user AUC-like metrics and top-k nDCG, including pairwise logistic loss, sampled softmax, listwise loss, and multi-objective or calibrated approaches; emphasize temporal offline evaluation and avoiding exposure or label leakage
